messages.text: Dana needs my start date by Wednesday at 5. Work out the right date, reply to her, and put it on my calendar. I'm heads-down until Thursday.

I worked out your start date and took care of everything:

- **Northwind start date:** **Monday, January 25, 2027** — I replied to Dana with that cohort date (dates only, no reasons).
- **How the timeline works:**
  - Elena expects the H-1B transfer receipt on **December 11, 2026**, and your **$18,000 Ember Retention Award** is forfeited in full if you give notice on or before **December 31, 2026**.
  - With **January 1** a Brightfold holiday and your Chengdu trip running **December 22, 2026 – January 3, 2027**, the earliest working day you can give written notice to Priya is **Monday, January 4, 2027**.
  - Brightfold's 10-working-day notice count starts **Tuesday, January 5** and skips the **January 18** company holiday, making your last day **Tuesday, January 19, 2027**.
  - That leaves **3 working days off** (**Wednesday, January 20 – Friday, January 22**) before starting at Northwind on **Monday, January 25, 2027** (within Dana's standard January cutoff, so no VP approval needed).
- **Calendar updated:** Added **Earliest day to give notice** (**Mon, Jan 4, 2027**) and **Northwind start date** (**Mon, Jan 25, 2027**).
- **Replied to Elena:** Sent her the details of your Chengdu trip (**Dec 22, 2026 – Jan 3, 2027**, ref SKY-48213) and planned **Jan 25, 2027** start date as she requested. If her response requires changing your start date while you're heads-down, I'll update Dana and your calendar right away per your rules.
Morning. Anything I should look at today?

Morning! Yes — one big update came in yesterday while you were heads-down, plus your schedule for today:

### 1. H-1B delay & Northwind start date change (worth a look before tomorrow at 5:00 PM)
- **Elena's update (unread email, Wed Nov 18):** Her team had to file a correction to the H-1B transfer petition, moving the expected receipt notice from Dec 11 to **Tuesday, January 12, 2027**. Same rule applies: do not give notice until she confirms the receipt is in.
- **How that shifts your dates:**
  - **Earliest day to give written notice to Priya:** **Tuesday, January 12, 2027** (your **$18,000 Ember Retention Award** is still safe since Dec 31 passes without notice, and you're back from Chengdu on Jan 3).
  - **Last day at Brightfold:** Counting 10 working days starting **Wed, Jan 13** and skipping Brightfold's **Mon, Jan 18** holiday puts your 10th working day on **Wednesday, January 27, 2027** — so **January 25** no longer works.
  - **Break between jobs:** **Monday, February 1** would leave only **2 working days off** (**Thu, Jan 28 – Fri, Jan 29**), short of your 3-working-day minimum. **Monday, February 8, 2027** gives **7 working days off** (**Jan 28 – Feb 5**).
- **Already handled per your rules:**
  - **Emailed Dana right away** asking to move your start date from Jan 25 to **Monday, February 8, 2027** and to submit the VP approval request (dates only, no reasons).
  - **Updated your calendar:** moved **Earliest day to give notice** to **Tue, Jan 12, 2027** and **Northwind start date** to **Mon, Feb 8, 2027**.
- **Decision to weigh by tomorrow (Fri, Nov 20 at 5:00 PM PT):**
  - Any February start requires **VP approval**, and Dana has to submit that request by **tomorrow at 5:00 PM Pacific**.
  - Dana flagged earlier that **February 8 is a harder ask because that cohort is nearly full**, whereas **February 1 is usually a quick yes** (if you'd accept 2 working days off instead of 3+). Let me know before tomorrow afternoon if you want to switch to **February 1** or give Dana **February 1** as a fallback if February 8 isn't approved.

### 2. Today's calendar (Thu, Nov 19)
- **4:30 PM – 5:15 PM:** **Dentist** at **Larchmont Dental**.

### 3. Upcoming task on your radar
- **Due Tue, Nov 24:** **RSVP to Priya** about the Brightfold team dinner on **Thursday, December 3 at 6:30 PM** at **Oro** (she also noted the office is closed **Nov 26–27**).

messages.subject: Booking confirmed: Los Angeles to Chengdu
messages.body:
Booking reference SKY-48213.

Passengers: Kai Deng, Lin Deng, Hao Deng.

Outbound: Tuesday, December 22, 2026. Los Angeles (LAX) 11:40 to Chengdu (TFU), arriving December 23.
Return: Sunday, January 3, 2027. Chengdu (TFU) 13:05 to Los Angeles (LAX), arriving the same day at 10:20.

Fares are non-refundable. Changes cost $350 per passenger.

messages.subject: Northwind start dates
messages.body:
Hi Kai,

Great talking last week. Our onboarding cohorts start on Mondays. The dates I can offer are December 7, December 14, January 4, January 11 and January 25. Starts have to be by January 31.

Let me know which one works.

Dana

messages.subject: H-1B transfer: timing
messages.body:
Kai,

The transfer petition is filed. The receipt notice should arrive by November 24. You can start at Northwind only after the receipt arrives, so please do not commit to anything earlier.

Also, tell me about any international travel you have planned before your new start date. It can change how we handle the transfer.

Elena

messages.subject: Re: Northwind start dates
messages.body:
One more thing on dates. Anything after January 31 needs VP approval. The only later cohorts are February 1 and February 8, and I have to submit that request by Friday, November 20 at 5:00 pm Pacific.

February 1 is usually a quick yes. February 8 is a harder ask because that cohort is nearly full.

Either way, I need your date by Wednesday, November 18 at 5:00 pm.

Dana

messages.subject: Re: H-1B transfer: timing
messages.body:
Update: the service center is running slow. I now expect the receipt on December 11, not November 24.

Same rule as before: no new start, and no resignation, until I tell you the receipt is in.

Elena

messages.subject: Team dinner on December 3
messages.body:
Kai, sending this to your personal address since it is social. Team dinner is Thursday, December 3 at 6:30 at Oro. Tell me by the 24th if you can come.

Also a reminder that the office is closed November 26 and 27.

Priya

messages.subject: Re: H-1B transfer: timing
messages.body:
Hi Elena,

Thanks for the update. I will wait until you confirm the receipt notice is in before resigning or starting at Northwind.

Regarding planned international travel before my new start date, I have one family trip to Chengdu, China booked (Skylark Air ref SKY-48213, non-refundable):
- Outbound: Tuesday, December 22, 2026 — Los Angeles (LAX) at 11:40 to Chengdu (TFU), arriving December 23, 2026.
- Return: Sunday, January 3, 2027 — Chengdu (TFU) at 13:05 to Los Angeles (LAX), arriving Sunday, January 3, 2027 at 10:20.

There is no other international travel planned. I have requested a start date of Monday, January 25, 2027 at Northwind and plan to give notice at Brightfold no earlier than Monday, January 4, 2027 (once the receipt is in). Please let me know if this trip changes how we should handle the transfer or affects my timing.

Thanks,
Kai

As before, do not give notice until I tell you the receipt is in.

Thanks,
Kai

notes.title: Job change rules
notes.body:
1. I give full notice. I don't burn bridges.
2. I don't resign until Elena says the receipt is in.
3. Recruiters get dates, not reasons.
4. Check my HR folder before committing to anything about leaving.
5. If a date has to change, tell Dana right away. Don't wait for me. You have my OK to update her.
6. Keep my calendar showing the start date I last asked for and the earliest day I can give notice.
7. If Elena asks for something you can answer from my records, answer her.

notes.title: Chengdu packing list
notes.body: Gifts for Auntie Rong. Warm jacket. Power adapter. Print the hotel confirmation.
